label: Forkable
description: Arcade tools for Forkable — list this week's meals, browse menus, and pick what you want delivered

tools.name: CheckMealRestrictions
tools.description:
Check whether picking this item (with the given modifier selections) would
conflict with the signed-in user's dietary restrictions.

Returns the list of conflict tags (e.g. `["dairy_free"]`) — empty if the
item is safe. Call this before picking the item as a meal to warn the user, or
to let the agent pick a different item.

parameters.name: menu_id
parameters.description: The menu the item belongs to: the `menu_id` listed with that menu item.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The menu item to check: the `item_id` of an item in a menu listing.

parameters.name: selections
parameters.description: Modifier picks as { modifier_id: [option_id, ...] }. Omit if the item has no modifiers. Defaults to no modifier picks.

tools.name: ListMenuItems
tools.description:
Fetch the full menu (sections, items, prices, modifiers) for one or more menu IDs.

Each item ships with the `item_id` and `menu_id` you'll need to pick it as your meal.

parameters.name: menu_ids
parameters.description: The Forkable menu IDs to fetch: the `available_menu_ids` of a delivery day in your weekly meals listing. At least one ID is required.

parameters.name: club_id
parameters.description: The meal club ID for the delivery: the `meal_club_id` of that delivery day in your weekly meals listing.

tools.name: ListMyMealsThisWeek
tools.description:
List your upcoming Forkable delivery days and what's currently picked for each.

Each entry shows the delivery date, current state (open / locked / delivered),
the meal currently assigned to you (`my_pick`), and the menu IDs whose items you
can swap your pick to. Results are sorted by delivery date.

An entry whose `my_pick.piece_id` is empty has no meal allocated to you yet, so
there is no pick to swap on it; picking a meal only replaces an existing pick.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: First day of the window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to an empty string, which starts the window on Monday of the current week.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many days from `from_date` to include in the window (1-31). Defaults to 7.

tools.name: PickMeal
tools.description:
Replace your assigned meal on one delivery with a different menu item.

Only works on deliveries that already have a meal allocated to you (a
non-empty `my_pick.piece_id`). Forkable's `replacePiece` mutation swaps an
existing pick; it can't create one from nothing — initial allocation
happens on the Forkable side.

The mutation returns the refreshed delivery; this tool surfaces the new pick
and the updated amount due.

parameters.name: delivery_id
parameters.description: The Forkable delivery ID: the `delivery_id` of a delivery day in your weekly meals listing.

parameters.name: piece_id
parameters.description: Your current piece ID for that delivery: the `my_pick.piece_id` of that delivery day in your weekly meals listing. This is what gets replaced. If `my_pick.piece_id` is empty, this delivery has no meal allocated to you yet and there is nothing to replace.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The menu item you want: the `item_id` of an item in a menu listing.

parameters.name: menu_id
parameters.description: The menu the chosen item belongs to: the `menu_id` listed with that menu item.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.description: Free-text note to the venue (e.g. 'no onions'). Defaults to an empty string, which sends no note.

parameters.name: selections
parameters.description: Modifier picks as { modifier_id: [option_id, ...] }. Omit if the item has no modifiers. Defaults to no modifier picks.

instructions.value: no onions, extra sauce on the side

tools.name: SkipMeal
tools.description:
Skip a day — removes your assigned meal from a Forkable order.

Use only when the delivery is still open for changes (`locked: false`
and not `past_late_order_deadline`).

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The order ID for the delivery you want to skip: the `order_id` of that delivery day in your weekly meals listing.

parameters.name: piece_id
parameters.description: Your current piece ID for that order: the `my_pick.piece_id` of that delivery day in your weekly meals listing.

summary:
Forkable is a workplace meal delivery service. This toolkit lets an Arcade agent browse this week's meal schedule, explore menus, check dietary compatibility, and swap or skip picks on open deliveries.

## Capabilities

- **Meal schedule visibility** — retrieve upcoming delivery days, current pick state (open / locked / delivered), and available menu IDs per day
- **Menu browsing** — fetch full menus including sections, items, prices, and modifier options for one or more menu IDs
- **Dietary safety checks** — validate whether a specific item + modifier combination conflicts with the signed-in user's dietary restrictions before committing a pick
- **Meal management** — swap an existing assigned meal for a different item, or skip a delivery day entirely (only while the order window is still open)

## Secrets

This toolkit authenticates directly with Forkable using your account credentials. Both secrets are required.

- `FORKABLE_EMAIL` — The email address associated with your Forkable account. This is the same address you use to log in to the Forkable web app.

- `FORKABLE_PASSWORD` — The password for your Forkable account. This is your standard login password from the Forkable web app. Because this credential grants full account access, treat it with the same care as any primary password and consider using a dedicated or rotated credential if your organization's Forkable plan supports it.

Store both values as Arcade secrets. See the [Arcade secrets guide](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) for setup instructions, or add them directly at https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets.
